content: Bahawalpur mein aandhi aa gayi hai — Circular Road pe kuch nazar nahi aa raha! Gaari band kar li hai. Rehat ka chowk bilkul andheray mein hai. #BahawalpurSandstorm
Sandstorm visibility zero in Bahawalpur. Multiple road accidents on Multan Road. Airport has suspended flights. Dust is entering homes — cover water and food immediately.
Victoria Hospital Bahawalpur mein emergency bhar gayi hai — do roz se zyada marez aa rahe hain, bed nahi hain. Kuch bachon ko floor par rakha hai. Ambulance bhi nahi mil rahi.

PMD Bahawalpur: Severe sandstorm — sustained winds 68km/h, gusts 90km/h from SW Cholistan direction. Visibility 50 metres. PM10: 1,800 µg/m³ (threshold: 150). Airport NOTAM issued. Road closures on Multan Road and Yazman Road.

DHO Bahawalpur: Victoria Hospital at 148% capacity. 210 patients vs 142 beds. 38 children on floor mats. Respiratory admissions from sandstorm AQI + seasonal gastroenteritis simultaneously overloading the facility. Punjab Health Dept alerted.
Multan Road, Bahawalpur — zero visibility. Speed 0km/h (normal 80km/h). 4 accidents reported in sandstorm. Road closed by traffic police.
PDMA Bahawalpur Environmental Monitor BHP-04: PM10 reading 1,842 µg/m³ (12× threshold). PM2.5: 689 µg/m³. Wind direction: SW 68km/h. Sandstorm origin: Cholistan Desert — no precipitation expected.
Rescue 1122 Bahawalpur: 14 accident calls on Multan Road in 1 hour during sandstorm. 6 injuries — 2 serious. Road accident tally rising.
Bahawalpur: Sandstorm warning. Wind 68km/h SW, gusts 90km/h. Visibility 50m. Temperature 41°C. No rain expected.
